answer: Each challenge is cryptographically entangled with a future beacon pulse: a threshold-BLS output remains unpredictable and unbiasable until its scheduled reveal, then derives the task seed and verifies the response against a prior commitment. Consequently, a sybil swarm cannot pre-compute solutions, farm them offline, or select identities after seeing favorable randomness. Any fable of instant scaling cannot bridge this causal gap; agents must remain accountable for fresh work.
